purpose: 개발 전 공통 데이터 계약. 응용 프로그램 구현이나 실제 시험 결과가 아님.

encoding.time_instant: ISO-8601 UTC Z; device captured/observed/occurred_at null when corresponding clock untrusted. UTC for records/schedules, monotonic for duration/retry/token freshness.
encoding.schema_transition: v1.4 상세 설계 개정(2026-11-05): MQTT schema_version=2/parking/v2와 기존 메시지 예제·시간값 유지. REST STOP의 starts_at=null(즉시)을 서버 issued_at으로 정규화하는 입력 규칙을 보완하고 설명 오류를 바로잡음. 정식 Schema/OpenAPI는 개발자료/09_구현설계/contracts 참조.

DeviceSnapshot.clock_synced: boolean; equals envelope; true iff clock_status.state is SYNCED or HOLDOVER
DeviceSnapshot.clock_status: ClockStatus; clock_synced=true iff state is SYNCED or HOLDOVER

EventRecord.overdue: boolean; true after unresolved threshold; retained independently of HELD

Geometry.roi_polygon_m: array of >=3 [finite x,finite y]; simple polygon
Geometry.exit_polygon_m: array of >=3 [finite x,finite y]; simple polygon

OperatingHours.windows: array of {weekday:integer1..7,start_hhmm:HH:mm,end_hhmm:HH:mm or24:00}; overnight split into two windows

Command.issued_at: UTC; normally trusted server time, immediate STOP exception may carry best available server UTC; TTL exception determines freshness

ImageMetadata.captured_at: trusted UTC original frame capture time|null; never changed when bytes are reused
ImageMetadata.clock_synced: boolean; trust of original captured_at, not upload time
ImageMetadata.width: integer1..1280; max(width,height)<=1280; preserve aspect ratio, no upscaling
ImageMetadata.height: integer1..1280; max(width,height)<=1280; preserve aspect ratio, no upscaling
ImageMetadata.created_at: trusted UTC job creation time|null; persisted for reboot age reconstruction
ImageMetadata.source_image_id: id|null; nonnull only when EVENT_CLOSE reuses an accepted CLOSE_CONFIRM JPEG

ImageRef.received_at: UTC; first server receipt of image status or JPEG, immutable
ImageRef.expires_at: UTC|null; file retention deadline once received JPEG; null if no JPEG stored

CommandView.result_data: CommandResultData; public ZoneView/EventDetail results keep confirmation_token=null. Authorized OPERATOR GET /api/commands/{id} may return the still-valid token.

ImageUpdate.captured_at: trusted UTC|null; null before capture or when capture clock untrusted
ImageUpdate.error_code: image_error_code|null; required nonnull for FAILED/EXPIRED, null otherwise

ClockStatus.error_bound_ms: integer>=0|null; valid adapter estimate rounded up, not a measured accuracy guarantee
ClockStatus.last_sync_at: UTC|null; most recent externally synchronized anchor, not latest health-poll time
ClockStatus.sync_age_ms: integer>=0|null; monotonic elapsed age of same-boot external sync anchor

STOP_GUIDANCE.starts_at: UTC; immediate MUST exactly equal Command.issued_at; scheduled MUST be later than issued_at and scope ZONE. Classify by this equality, never unreliable receiver wall time.
STOP_GUIDANCE.expires_at: UTC|null; pause ending, independent command TTL

RESUME_GUIDANCE.identity_confirmed: boolean; true only after operator verifies same vehicle for OBSERVATION_REVIEW
RESUME_GUIDANCE.reason: string1..200; evidence required for identity confirmation

config/reported.replay: publish only newest report; durable config history goes to events

request.policy: Policy without version/base_version/change_class; server derives them

request.params: REST command params: STOP starts_at=null means immediate, UTC string means future schedule; server generates pause_id and replaces null with Command.issued_at. Other types use existing CommandParams.

response.body: CommandView; confirmation_token included only OPERATOR while valid

response.note: PENDING/FAILED/no image =>404; EXPIRED=>410; status metadata remains available in ImageRef.

ordering.device_seq: Persisted every new snapshot message including heartbeat; retry preserves original sequence. Current device projection accepts only higher sequence. Per-event history always inserted after dedup, and terminal events never reopen.
ordering.view_revision: Persisted server per-zone counter increments on any visible change including freshness transition; REST and SSE same ZoneView. Client accepts only greater revision; equal is idempotent.
ordering.event_vs_current: events.event describes event_id, including closed event; snapshot describes actual device now and may have no current event or a different event.
ordering.image_status: HTTP201/200 after durable JPEG+metadata storage makes AVAILABLE authoritative. Late PENDING/FAILED/EXPIRED from edge cannot overwrite AVAILABLE. Only server retention may turn AVAILABLE into EXPIRED. Device status messages are deduplicated and ordered per image by device_seq. FAILED and pre-upload EXPIRED are terminal; no image replacement or retry under a new ID for the same automatic shot.

retention.images: 7 days from trusted original captured_at, else first received_at; never extended by retry or reused bytes; AVAILABLE becomes EXPIRED/RETENTION_EXPIRED at deadline, API410 immediately, file cleanup within24h
retention.closed_event_summary: 30 days from trusted device closed_at; if null or untrusted, first close-message received_at
retention.command: 30 days from server terminal_at; missing result uses expires_at+5000ms as terminal_at; late actual results remain distinguishable
retention.live_operational_state: active event minimal state, non-cleared pauses, unacked metadata and dedup key/hash/state survive history cleanup; no extension to expired images
retention.edge_images: Pending immutable JPEG <=24h from job creation; remove local bytes after confirmed server storage or terminal FAILED/EXPIRED. Keep image ID/kind/event/hash/final status/error metadata with operational dedup records; event outbox is never deleted as photo cleanup.
retention.http_idempotency_after_resource_expiry: Preserve minimal user/key/action/hash/resource identity tombstone; after original HTTP resource/response retention expires, same request returns GONE/410 and is never recreated. Different action/body under same user/key remains IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/409.

version_rules.timing: receive new version; pin active/event until current event closes; activate before next event
version_rules.geometry: RECONFIGURE pause -> close current event preserving old geometry -> authenticated on-site apply-policy(version) validates calibration/vision profile and activates received version, leaves pauses -> observe new zone clear3s -> fresh photo -> RESUME exact RECONFIGURE/REARM pauses
version_rules.manual_use_type: server-owned overlay; nonnull takes display precedence over edge estimated use_type; reviews never close incident
version_rules.identity_review: OBSERVATION_REVIEW pause; RESUME requires identity_confirmed=true with on-site/additional evidence reason, same current event, healthy camera, fresh purpose-bound photo token; preserve event/count; otherwise CLOSE and rearm

invariants: No command result APPLIED is inferred from HTTP202 or MQTT PUBACK.
STOP ignores expected policy/mode mismatch but requires authentication, valid EVENT target, and delivery freshness.
RESUME releases only requested pause_ids. Other active or acknowledgment-required pauses remain.
CLOSE_EVENT requires current matching event and fresh purpose-bound token; close + REARM_REQUIRED are atomic. No new event until observed clear zone3s plus explicit resume.
Snapshot token binds purpose, request command, image, boot, current event, received/active/event policy versions, mode revision, and30s monotonic lifetime; successful use consumes it.
PHYSICAL and OUTPUT_FAULT pauses cannot be cleared through web commands.
Schedule expiry becomes ACK_REQUIRED; no implicit resume. Future schedule registration must be delivered within command TTL.
Local state and durable message outbox are persisted before publishing; playback attempt and count are persisted before actual sound.
Dedup key reuse with altered payload is a conflict, not another execution.
Unknown schema or fields must not be silently interpreted as a known safe state.
overdue survives HELD and blocks new automatic guidance after threshold; current snapshot and historical event both retain it.
Snapshot device_seq/boot_id/clock_synced must equal its envelope; observed_at describes state capture, while event timestamp remains attributable to its event.

Immediate STOP APPLIED means logical inhibition and driver stop confirmation, not verified acoustic silence; stop failure retains pause and emits FAILED with FAILED/UNKNOWN output. Future schedule APPLIED means registration only.
OBSERVATION_REVIEW can be released only with same-vehicle attestation reason and healthy imagery; inability to establish identity takes CLOSE then clear-zone rearm.
Geometry activation is a local installation confirmation operation, not an implicit side effect of RESUME.
Before first policy is installed, received/active versions may be null, camera_health=RECONFIGURE, and automatic guidance/new incidents are inhibited. RESUME cannot bypass missing policy.

Current snapshot may update corresponding current-event summary fields by device sequence; historical EventRecord and terminal closure are persisted from durable events, without reopening a closed event.

Allowed scopes: STOP_GUIDANCE DEVICE|ZONE|EVENT, RESUME_GUIDANCE DEVICE, REQUEST_SNAPSHOT DEVICE, CLOSE_EVENT EVENT. STOP EVENT and CLOSE require matching current target; RESUME target matches token current event or null; REQUEST_SNAPSHOT target is null.
STOP pause source is SCHEDULE for future ZONE starts_at, otherwise USER. Device-generated safety pauses use their fixed system source.
Each event reserves at most one FIRST_GUIDANCE and one EVENT_CLOSE job. Photo failure cannot block guidance, event closure, durable metadata, or incident count.
JPEG upload identity/content are immutable; server-confirmed AVAILABLE cannot be regressed by delayed device status. Image and MQTT ACK statuses are distinct enums.
IMAGE_STATUS_CHANGED requires image_update and event=null; other events require image_update=null. Photo belongs to image_update.event_id while snapshot remains actual current state.
The event outbox100MiB and image queue50MiB are independent quotas; removing expired image bytes never deletes incident/outbox state.
clock_synced=true iff snapshot.clock_status.state in SYNCED/HOLDOVER; nullable observation timestamps remain null when created untrusted, and records are not rewritten later.

UNTRUSTED blocks and stops automatic guidance, resets continuous stop to0 and exposes CLOCK_UNTRUSTED without clearing any pause or event/count.5s continuous trust recovery precedes fresh candidate accumulation.
New control and scheduled pauses require issuer/receiver clock trust. Immediate STOP alone uses authenticated MQTT remaining TTL>0 plus publisher monotonic60s despite clock uncertainty.
Confirmation freshness requires both command60s and capture30s. A late upload must not retroactively create a token or APPLIED result.
First install uses existing Policy schema and requires local calibration activation, clear zone3s and explicit fresh-photo resume. Seed/config credentials are separate from contract data.

Immediate versus scheduled STOP is determined by params.starts_at==issued_at versus starts_at>issued_at, not receiver clock. This prevents untrusted issuer/receiver UTC from converting an immediate stop into a schedule.

A fresh candidate needs 300000ms before first or repeat guidance. Repeat also needs >=30000ms since first playback ended. At pinned incident age600000ms overdue wins and blocks new guidance, including after a late candidate reset. Current playback is not stopped solely by becoming overdue.

clock_policy_boundaries.condition: external normal, stratum2, same-boot age300000, valid E1000
external normal, same-boot age300001, valid E1000
same-boot trusted anchor age1800000, daemon valid E1000
same-boot anchor age1800001 or valid E1001

clock_policy_boundaries.expected: HOLDOVER; do not stop solely for network loss

local_maintenance.access: authenticated on-site operator only; not exposed as remote browser execution

checks: matching calibration/reference points and vision profile available
apply-policy.effect: active_policy_version=version; increment mode_revision; invalidate tokens; keep RECONFIGURE and REARM_REQUIRED; emit CONFIG_ACTIVATED

checks: physical stop switch has been released
release-physical.effect: clear only specified PHYSICAL pause; no bypass to remaining pauses

checks: operator verifies test output and stop while automatic guidance remains held
confirm-output.effect: clear only specified OUTPUT_FAULT; remaining pauses remain

checks: same remaining guards as remote resume except remote photo token
resume-local.effect: clear exactly eligible pause IDs, preserve event/count and start fresh candidate after recovery stabilization

automatic_jobs.FIRST_GUIDANCE: Exactly one job per event on first guidance attempt: persist its ID/status with the attempt/count, retain current valid frame before output, enqueue encoding/upload asynchronously. Failure never blocks actual output; no repeat-shot for second attempt or failed playback.
automatic_jobs.EVENT_CLOSE: Exactly one job per event at OBSERVED_EXIT or MANUAL closure. Natural exit uses current valid frame (empty zone permitted). Unusable image yields FAILED/NO_VALID_FRAME, without delaying closure. MANUAL reuses bytes from the successful CLOSE_CONFIRM token image under a separate image_id; preserve original capture metadata/hash and source_image_id. No new capture required.

photo_policy.trigger_atomicity: Record one job identity and intended status in the same SQLite transaction as first attempt or event closure; outbox status is separate from JPEG storage. Worker failure is a photo-only event.
photo_policy.queue: One asynchronous image worker with at most2 waiting jobs (running job excluded); if full mark new job FAILED/QUEUE_FULL. Cap total unsent JPEG files at50MiB independent of100MiB event-message outbox; reject only new photo with FAILED/IMAGE_STORAGE_FULL. Do not evict events or old pending JPEG to fit a new shot.
photo_policy.capture: Use latest frame already accepted by the observation loop; never wait for camera or network in guidance control. JPEG conversion/disk/upload are asynchronous. If no current valid frame, FAILED/NO_VALID_FRAME. Normal image quality and freshness gates are unchanged.

retry.terminal: other HTTP4xx -> FAILED/HTTP_REJECTED; 409 hash conflict -> FAILED/IMAGE_ID_CONFLICT
retry.retry_after: When supplied, delay=max(normal backoff,min(valid Retry-After,120000ms)); parsing HTTP-date requires trusted UTC. Never exceed remaining24h lifetime. Invalid header ignored.
retry.identity: Keep same image_id, original metadata, bytes and SHA-256 across retry; do not recapture or substitute.
retry.age: Elapsed age uses boot monotonic clock. After reboot reconstruct only from trusted persisted created_at and current trusted UTC; if unavailable mark EXPIRED/AGE_UNKNOWN and remove bytes. At24h mark EXPIRED/RETRY_EXHAUSTED. A successful upload releases local bytes.

photo_policy.image_update_semantics: Each device status transition emits IMAGE_STATUS_CHANGED with event=null and image_update; envelope event_id equals image_update.event_id. Snapshot always reports current actual device state, even if the photo belongs to an older closed event. Other events carry image_update=null. HTTP storage response can update server projection before MQTT arrives.
photo_policy.display: UI shows kind/captured_at/status/error. PENDING means not yet viewable; AVAILABLE is viewable via authenticated GET; FAILED has no deliverable file; EXPIRED is past retention/upload lifetime. Never show failed or pending as event failure. Automatic photos have no control token.
photo_policy.recovery: On reboot, queued job without fully persisted immutable JPEG becomes FAILED/RESTART_INCOMPLETE; complete pending JPEG follows age reconstruction. Job identity remains consumed; no new automatic capture for it.
photo_policy.manual_confirmation: For RESUME_CONFIRM/CLOSE_CONFIRM, both60s command expiry and30s from capture apply. Server storage must complete while capture token lifetime remains positive, and result must reach operator before expiry for use. Otherwise record FAILED/SNAPSHOT_EXPIRED command result without issuing token; later same-photo upload is history-only, never retroactively APPLIED or a new token. A result issued in time but arriving late may record historical readiness but its expired token must be omitted/disabled; device always rechecks monotonic deadline. VIEW produces no token and obeys command60s for its command result; late upload is history-only. Other photo failures use FAILED/OBSERVATION_UNSAFE or FAILED/STORAGE_FULL at command level, with precise image_error_code in image status.
photo_policy.manual_result_freshness: Server exposes confirmation_token only while trusted server now+E < trusted original captured_at+30000ms-1000ms and stored result still permits it;1000ms reserves capture-clock uncertainty. token_valid_for_ms is reduced to the conservative remaining time, never refreshed by GET/retry. Expired result cannot be used; final device monotonic check remains authoritative.

clock_policy.baseline: Linux chrony tracking adapter; equivalent adapter permitted only with same trust evidence and fields because board OS is unconfirmed. QCS610 platform is confirmed; exact board OS/runtime and adapter availability require physical verification.
clock_policy.bound: E_ms = ceil(1000*(abs(System time seconds)+Root dispersion seconds+max(Root delay seconds,0)/2)). This is our initial conservative operating threshold, not proof of physical UTC accuracy.
clock_policy.sampling: Probe every5s. Record external sync anchor only on actual new external reference synchronization; repeated health polls never reset sync_age_ms. Compute age with monotonic time within the same boot.
clock_policy.synced: Leap status Normal, stratum1..15, genuine external source (no unsynchronized/local-only fallback), current valid error estimate E<=1000ms, last external sync age<=300000ms.
clock_policy.holdover: Previous trusted external sync exists in this same boot, daemon current error estimate remains valid E<=1000ms and sync age<=1800000ms; SYNCED conditions no longer hold. Network loss alone is not a stop trigger.
clock_policy.untrusted: No valid qualifying state; probe failure lasting >=10000ms; or abs(deltaUTC-deltaMonotonic)>500ms between observations. Following a clock jump, require a new valid external synchronization before trust restoration; do not relabel the old anchor. Reboot starts untrusted until evidence is reacquired.
clock_policy.effect: clock_synced=false; newly created captured/observed/occurred_at=null. Inhibit new and stop ongoing automatic guidance, reset continuous_stop_ms=0, expose CLOCK_UNTRUSTED. This is a quality guard, not a new pause_source; incident/count/existing pauses survive.
clock_policy.recovery: Require trusted conditions continuously for5s before new stop accumulation; after recovery a fresh300s candidate is needed. Existing USER/RESTART/OBSERVATION_REVIEW and all other pauses remain; clock recovery does not clear them.
clock_policy.schedule: Use trusted interval [now-E,now+E]. A scheduled-stop interval overlap inhibits output; operating-hours permission requires the full trusted interval inside the union of allowed windows. Merge adjacent full-day windows across midnight. When untrusted, automatic output remains inhibited and pending schedules are conservatively held; no expiry-driven auto resume.
clock_policy.command_expiry: Except immediate STOP, require trusted issuer and receiver; receive only if now+E+1000ms < expires_at. The extra1000ms is the maximum issuer uncertainty. Also enforce command60s and token30s independently. Queue/retry duration uses monotonic time, not wall-clock jumps.
clock_policy.immediate_stop_exception: Even if server/device time is untrusted, authenticated immediate STOP may be published within server monotonic60s and received only with a positive broker-delivered MQTT remaining expiry. Its issued_at/expires_at carry best available server UTC for record format, not freshness proof. Apply this TTL path for all immediate STOP so an untrusted issuer cannot cause a safe stop rejection. Future scheduled STOP does not qualify.
clock_policy.server: Same trust adapter and limits. When UNTRUSTED, defer newly issued non-immediate-STOP control commands and schedule creation with CLOCK_UNTRUSTED; do not infer success for already queued/in-flight commands. Immediate STOP uses the exception.
clock_policy.photos: Capture clock untrusted => captured_at=null and clock_synced=false; no confirmation token. Photos may still be history records. Restored UTC must not rewrite original timestamps.
clock_policy.scope: No new pause_source; clock_status is diagnostics/trust, while mode still follows actual pause set. UI must show CLOCK_UNTRUSTED even if mode says AUTO.
clock_policy.stop_classification: Immediate STOP is identified by params.starts_at exactly equal to Command.issued_at, independent of receiver UTC. Scheduled STOP has starts_at>issued_at and scope ZONE. Other relationship is INVALID_SCHEMA. When clock is untrusted, accept only immediate path; never register a future schedule under that exception.
clock_policy.request_snapshot_untrusted: REQUEST_SNAPSHOT for VIEW, RESUME or CLOSE_EVENT is rejected CLOCK_UNTRUSTED if server or device is UNTRUSTED. Immediate STOP is the only exception. captured_at=null is possible for automatic closure/history photos, not a bypass for fresh remote confirmation.

initial_setup.scope: Exactly1 zone and1 device initially. Backend config seed creates registered IDs and VIEWER/OPERATOR accounts; rerun is idempotent by IDs and never silently overwrites existing policy or credentials. Actual secrets are not included in this package.
initial_setup.device_configuration: Deploy device_id,zone_id,MQTT-TLS endpoint,HTTPS base URL,CA reference and individual MQTT/HTTPS credentials through a separate protected local config. Broker ACL and HTTP credential are scoped to that device. Do not embed secrets into Policy or committed JSON/examples. HTTP device authentication uses an opaque per-device Bearer token (not JWT). Server persists only a credential hash; JSESSIONID and X-CSRF-TOKEN are web-only names.
initial_setup.policy_input: AI supplies measured Geometry (ROI/exit polygons,calibration_id,reference_points), vision_profile_id and calibration verification JSON. Backend combines these with agreed Timers and OperatingHours using existing Policy shape, validates membership/polygons/reference points/profile identity, then calls existing PUT /api/zones/{id}/policy. First expected_version=0; server assigns version1/base_version0. Example policy3/4 elsewhere remains a version-change example.
initial_setup.admin_ui: OPERATOR policy JSON upload/preview with validation errors and existing PUT action; show zone/device/profile/geometry preview and expected_version. Freehand ROI drawing UI is excluded. Browser must not run local apply-policy.
installation_sequence: Seed registered zone/device/accounts and inject individual secrets
Check TLS/auth, MQTT namespace parking/v2, schema2 and device IDs
Receive/validate AI geometry+vision profile+calibration result and submit existing policy API
Device persists policy but remains RECONFIGURE; no automatic incidents/guidance
On-site authenticated apply-policy(version) validates matching calibration/profile and activates policy
Observe normal clear zone continuously3s, obtain fresh RESUME photo, explicitly RESUME eligible RECONFIGURE/REARM_REQUIRED/RESTART pauses
Verify clock trust, remaining pauses, camera quality and status snapshot before automatic operation
initial_setup.no_bypass: First policy installation also requires RECONFIGURE -> local apply-policy -> valid clear zone3s -> fresh photo -> explicit resume. Missing geometry/profile/credentials or time trust blocks operational entry; local resume cannot skip corresponding guard.

ownership.DATA: Dataset acquisition, labels, split manifests, ground truth and evaluation records. Does not generate online MQTT messages.
ownership.AI: Board environment, camera/inference/tracking, decision state, physical outputs and platform adapters; integrates backend-owned device SDK on the real board.
ownership.BACKEND: Owns wire contracts, portable device communication/storage SDK and simulator, broker/credentials, Spring APIs/persistence/SSE/deployment/observability. No real-board wiring or model porting ownership.
ownership.FRONTEND: Owns React administrator UI, API/SSE integration and freshness/command/photo displays; backend manages contract and integration acceptance.

initial_setup.known_unknowns: QCS610 platform confirmed by user and seminar. Exact carrier/OS/ABI, camera, venue, available runtimes/libraries, physical output interfaces and measured performance require AI board verification. Network contract schema2 remains fixed.

guidance_policy_v14.unresolved_origin: first confirmed candidate start, pinned for this event; not reset by movement/hold
guidance_policy_v14.legal_interpretation: Five minutes is the selected experimental guidance delay, not a nationwide legality threshold.
guidance_policy_v14.unresolved_choice: 10 minutes is a team-selected initial setting, not prescribed by the reference.
guidance_policy_v14.timing_validation: unresolved_ms must be greater than first_guidance_ms; reject invalid upload as INVALID_SCHEMA
guidance_policy_v14.legacy_policy_handling: First deployment uses 300000/600000. If v1.3 policy already registered, upload next monotonic policy version as TIMING; current incident remains pinned until closure.
